warnings: Same generic TYPE-section situation as หน้า20 — symbolic span 'L' only, no position/grid_ref, no plan view in this house assigns these marks to grid segments. Spec-only per §7.

B5A/B6A/B7A print two zones (SECTION_1-1 near support, SECTION_2-2 at midspan) with the same curtailment pattern as B2/B3/B4/B6 on หน้า20 — extra top steel near supports migrating to extra bottom steel at midspan; recorded the same way, via a note on the affected face rather than a separate zone field.
B8A prints only one section (no L/5 zone) — uniform, symmetric top/bottom.

The primed marks (B1', B2', B3', B4') print only ONE section each, but B2'/B3'/B4' additionally show a fixed '0.50' or '0.70' offset before the symbolic 'L' on their long-section sketch (not present on B1') — read as marking a short stub/offset zone near one end (e.g. a lintel or short cantilever), but the drawing gives no further explanation and no grid position; transcribed as printed_as text on the element rather than interpreted further.

B6A's SECTION_1-1 and SECTION_2-2 read as nearly identical top/bottom compositions (3-DB12+2-DB16 / 2-DB16+3-DB12 at both ends) unlike B5A's/B7A's clearer curtailment — recorded as printed; flagged as a case where the curtailment pattern is less pronounced than its neighbours, not re-interpreted to force a difference.
